paragraphs: Kapsch TrafficCom sells tolling and traffic management technology, set out on its own page as a portfolio of ITS, or intelligent transportation system, technologies. The portfolio menu on that page runs from toll collection for multi-lane free flowing traffic to location based toll solutions. It also lists urban traffic management, motorway traffic management, and bridge and tunnel management.

Buyers named on the page include the Waka Kotahi NZ Transport Agency, which awarded three video based tolling projects. San Bernardino County appears in a second item, where an express lanes network is to be extended as the county prepares for population growth. The city of León is listed as modernising its traffic management with Kapsch TrafficCom.

The same page counts realised projects in more than 50 countries. Recent items report satellite based toll collection taken into operation in the Netherlands. Another item reports a toll transponder plant in Mississauga, Ontario.
